(Shri Manoj Jain - Advocate For Respondent No.1) This appeal coming on for
conciliation this day, the Bench passed the following:

AWARD This appeal by the appellant/claimant under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of the award dated 07.08.2013 passed by First Additional Member, MACT, Neemuch, District Neemuch in Claim Case No.83/2013 and has been placed before this Lok Adalat u/s. 20 of the Legal Services & Authorities Act,
1987.
Both the parties have agreed to settle the appeal as per the terms of compromise filed by the parties.
The amount of Rs.75,000/- is enhanced.
